The three look-back windows: what differs between them

Methodology the objective function, the Sharpe ratio and how the numbers are computed▾

The objective function the annealers minimise

The energy of a selection x (xi = 1 if stock i is held): risk, minus expected return, plus stressed risk, plus a penalty on the number of stocks, plus a sector-spread term.

The Sharpe ratio: how the result is measured

Weekly returns after costs, above the Treasury-bill rate, annualised.
